subject.title: feat(apps): add native mobile Automations parity

question: Should native mobile Automations ship with this focused management subset while creation, cloning, and advanced delivery and failure-routing editing remain Control UI-only?
rationale: The implementation is a substantial new native-app capability, and the canonical issue plus protected labels explicitly reserve final mobile feature scope for maintainer judgment.

options.title: Approve Focused Mobile Parity
options.body: Accept the proposed search, inspection, safe mutation, and history subset after the stale invalid-spec refresh bug is fixed and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Require Broader Parity
options.body: Keep the PR open and request additional mobile creation, cloning, or advanced editing capabilities before accepting the feature direction.

options.title: Keep Control UI Primary
options.body: Decline the expanded native management surface and retain only the existing compact mobile controls.

recommendation.title: Approve Focused Mobile Parity
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed search, inspection, safe mutation, and history subset after the stale invalid-spec refresh bug is fixed and exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available current-main history is the recently merged cross-platform native Skills parity work and the adjacent Automations implementation.
